items.author: Nathan Lambert
items.title: Teaching Everyone to Fish for Tokens
takeaways: This is a one line excerpt about Nvidia encouraging companies to build their own AI models instead of buying access from Anthropic or OpenAI, so there is not enough detail here to change any build decisions yet.

Watch for more information on cost, complexity, and support before considering building your own model versus using existing AI providers, since building your own is usually far more expensive and time consuming.
For most health-tech founders, buying access to established AI models remains the safer and faster path unless a clear, detailed case for building your own emerges.
